title: Answer 404 instead of 403 for posts you don't own

findings.label: intended
findings.why: Announced in the PR description: "Editing or deleting someone else's post now answers 404 Not Found instead of 403 Forbidden, so the API doesn't confirm which post ids exist.". The diff changes abort(403) to abort(404) in both edit and delete endpoints when the post author doesn't match the current user, matching the described behavior change.
